violated_contract: A service-boundary fake must accept the real API's explicit no-retry control when it delegates the same local write semantics. The hermetic document-set wrapper rejected retry=None, so a real bounded projection-debt write raised TypeError before the subsequent durable audio-content marker could be recorded.
canonical_prevention: Accept the explicit retry=None keyword at the hermetic document-set adapter without forwarding it to the third-party in-memory fake, which performs no RPC. Preserve timeout, replacement, merge and subcollection behavior; reject non-None retry policies rather than pretending to simulate them. Exercise the real projection-debt writer against the adapter and verify persisted fields, plus merge/child retention and explicit rejection of unsupported retry policies.
